answer: Our economy pins each voting agent to a locked bond and a unique human attestation, then pays per verified identity instead of per key. To mount a Sybil attack you must fund a separate bond and attestation for every fake agent, so your capital cost grows linearly with the number of forged votes while the reward stays fixed. Like a river grinding basalt, that steady cost dissipates any plume of fake accounts before they can sway a vote.
